# FCIDensity

Module: **FTI** · directory: `FTI/src/FCI` · binary: `FTI/src/Programs/FCI/FCIDensity`

```text
FCIDensity, version 0.01

Usage: FCIDensity [options] 

Options:

system options:
    --input-states : use a file to describe the state as a linear combination
    -p, --nbr-particles : number of particles (overriding the one found in the vector file name if greater than 0) (default value = 0)
    -x, --nbr-sitex : number of sites along the x direction (default value = 3)
    -y, --nbr-sitey : number of sites along the y direction (default value = 3)
    --import-onebody : import information on the tight binding model from a file
    --coefficients-only : only compute the one body coefficients that are requested to evaluate the density profile
    --recompute-hilbert : do not store the Hilbert spaces (decreasing the memory consumption)

plot options:
    --output : output file name (default output name replace the .vec extension of the input file with .rho.dat)

parallelization options:
    -S, --SMP : enable SMP mode
    --processors : number of processors to use in SMP mode (default value = 2)
    --smp-profil : enable SMP profiling, the name of the log file  has to be passed as argument

precalculation options:
    --use-precomputed : use precomputed matrix elements to do the plot

misc options:
    -h, --help : display this help

global options:
    --append-cmdline : append command line to file
```
